title: myriopteron horsfieldii
intro: Myriopteron horsfieldii, commonly known as Horsfield's fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various forms of alternative medicine due to its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Myriopteron horsfieldii are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating coughs and relieving congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
